item: host-type item (R49): three doors, prize uniform, subject chose A; host opened B and B is empty; host is informed with probability alpha, otherwise uninformed; informed host always opens B when B is empty, else C; uninformed host opens B or C uniformly even if the prize is there
question_main: P(host was informed | observed empty B)
model: DSH subagent, reported by the harness as deepseek-flash; exact version and decoding settings not exposed
protocol: each row is an independent clean context; the participant was told not to use tools, not to read files and not to search; no key or neighbouring variant was shown
caveats: repeated calls of one model are not independent people
self-reported 'first instinct' is not a direct observation of the first internal answer
all-correct results are a ceiling check for this model, not a human measurement
